name: widemark
description: Compact Chrome bookmark side panel extension for browsing, search, organization, styling, and local duplicate checks.

scripts.validate: node --check scripts/build-extension.cjs && node --check scripts/package-extension.cjs && node --check scripts/generate-store-assets.cjs
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: echo 'Building Chrome Extension...' && npm run package && ./scripts/sync-to-windows.sh
scripts.package: npm run check && npm test && npm run compile && node scripts/package-extension.cjs
